decisions.reason: This air fin cooler remains very close to the firm's core heat-exchanger knowledge, so strong absorptive capacity and another year of market learning make continued retention the likely choice.

As a close extension of the established condenser business, it benefits from high related knowledge, and with Product B already withdrawn the remaining rationalization risk is lower but still present.
The tube liner fits the firm's installed-base service model and corrosion know-how, giving it a strong knowledge fit and good scope for incremental improvement rather than exit.
This customized air cooler line matches the firm's solution-oriented strategy, engineering capabilities and broad customer base especially well, so it is very unlikely to be discontinued.
These repair inserts reinforce the lifecycle-service business and rely on existing maintenance expertise, which supports continued commercialization and lowers withdrawal risk.
